item.title: The Latest: Iran’s Supreme Leader Khamenei killed in US-Israeli attack
item.description: Iranian Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei was killed in a major attack on Iran launched by Israel and the United States, throwing the future of the Islamic Republic into doubt and raising the risk of regional instability.
